mapper.select: insert into eas_bank_account_history (history_id, number_code, name, bank_account_number, company, bank, is_by_currency, currency, account, property, open_date, account_type, history_date, history_version) select eas_bank_account_history_s.nextval, nvl(t2.ref_v05,'HX'||t2.bank_account_id) as number_code, t2.bank_account_name as name, t2.bank_account_num as bank_account_number, (select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = t2.company_id) company, t2.ref_v04 as bank, 'true' as is_by_currency, (select fc.eas_code from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code=t2.currency)currency, t2.gld_account_code as account, t2.bank_account_type as property, t2.opening_date open_date, t2.ref_v02 as account_type, sysdate as history_date, #{historyVersion} from csh_bank t, csh_bank_account t2 where t.bank_id = t2.bank_id and t.enabled_flag = 'Y' and t2.enabled_flag = 'Y' and nvl(t2.code,'null') not in ('200')
select nvl(max(t.history_version),0)+1 as history_version from eas_bank_account_history t

select * from (select number_code, name, bank_account_number, company, bank, is_by_currency, currency, account, property, open_date, account_type from eas_bank_account_history t where exists (select 1 from csh_bank_account cba where nvl(cba.ref_v05,'HX'||cba.bank_account_id)=t.number_code and cba.code='200') and t.history_version = #{historyVersion} minus select number_code, name, bank_account_number, company, bank, is_by_currency, currency, account, property, open_date, account_type from eas_bank_account_history t where exists (select 1 from csh_bank_account cba where nvl(cba.ref_v05,'HX'||cba.bank_account_id)=t.number_code and cba.code='200') and t.history_version = #{historyVersion} - 1 union all select number_code, name, bank_account_number, company, bank, is_by_currency, currency, account, property, open_date, account_type from eas_bank_account_history t1 where exists (select 1 from csh_bank_account cba where nvl(cba.ref_v05,'HX'||cba.bank_account_id) = t1.number_code and nvl(cba.code, '1') not in('200')) and t1.history_version = #{historyVersion}) v
